_experiment.description: Magnitude-based selection criterion with the same manifold adjust step. Selects argmin |w_ij| globally at each step; adjustment is identical to the manifold baseline. Run via: python -m sparsifier.magnitude_sparsifier experiments/e09_magnitude_search.json. Any difference vs baseline is attributable solely to the selection criterion (manifold d_W vs magnitude |w|).
literature: Han et al. 2015: magnitude pruning competitive when paired with retraining — this checks whether the same holds with manifold adjust instead
Molchanov et al. 2019: systematic comparison of magnitude, first-order Taylor, and second-order importance metrics
